_comment: The template create_persona expands. Six authored fields arrive from the interview (name, description, system_prompt, temperament, voice design, colour); everything else is this file, the colour ramp, and the install's environment. Structure mirrors Sulivan's manifest, the reference resident.

tool_grants._comment: Resident defaults. No dev, no briefs; those are the operator's own surfaces.

deep_model._comment: Named, never pathed. The id and context come from the install's environment at creation time, so a persona made on this machine runs what this machine downloaded.
